summary: Caledonia Mining Corp. Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, containing a press release providing a quarterly production update for its Blanket Mine in Zimbabwe. The release reports Q2 2026 gold production of 17,360 ounces, an 18% increase from Q1 2026, and reaffirms full-year 2026 guidance of 72,000–76,500 ounces. There are no terms related to corporate transactions, board recommendations, or third-party advisors. The filing is a routine operational update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, and thus does not qualify as a special situation under the defined criteria.
